name: How can I prevent door hinge problems in the future?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent door hinge problems in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing door hinge problems involves regular maintenance. Periodically inspect hinges for loose screws and tighten them as needed. Lubricate hinges with a silicone-based spray or white lithium grease at least once a year to prevent squeaking and reduce wear. Ensure doors are not overloaded or forced open/closed, which can strain hinges. Addressing minor issues like slight misalignment early can prevent them from escalating into more significant and costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent door hinge problems by regularly tightening loose screws, lubricating hinges annually, and avoiding forceful door operation.
